    After a lot of fighting the system and helpful suggestions from the magical
    realm of the almight LISP, APL and Array Theory wizzards of the world At last!
    A true chance to be bored out of your skull:

    A written proposal on Extended Array Functions for Lisp-Macine LISP has been
    written and is available in several different flavors for your casual perusal,
    enjoyment, or annoyance:

    At a terminal:  KLE;ARFDOC LPT
    For Hard Copy:  KLE;ARFDOC XGP
    For Masochists: KLE;ARFDOC >

    I gladly welcome any and everyones comments and suggestions ESPECIALLY on 
    names for the numerous functions which are presented, that will be reasonably
    mnemonic and meaningfull.  Send your comments to KLE, and/or BUG-LISPM and they
    will probably be incorporated into the document, and/or appended to the end of
    it.

    Thanks --54.
